label: Heritage Paint
description: Period-correct classic-car colors with their finishes folded in — coach paint, lacquer and early metallics, never modern effect coats.

items.name: rosso-corsa
items.text: Rosso Corsa red, decades of hand-rubbed lacquer giving the gloss real depth

items.name: racing-green
items.text: British Racing Green so deep it reads black in shade, flatted and polished to a quiet mirror

items.name: silver-arrow
items.text: bare-metal racing silver, panel-beaten aluminium showing faint hammer memory under thin clear lacquer

items.name: bleu-de-france
items.text: Bleu de France racing blue with a soft period sheen, cooler at the shoulders where the light falls away

items.name: old-english-white
items.text: Old English White, a warm cream gloss that lets the chrome do the shining

items.name: burgundy-lake
items.text: deep burgundy lake, coach-painted and hand-lined with a single gold coachline along the swage

items.name: sable-coach-black
items.text: coach-painted sable black so wet-looking the sky slides across the panels

items.name: ivory-over-midnight
items.text: ivory over midnight blue, the two-tone split along a chrome swage line

items.name: powder-blue-marigold
items.text: powder blue with a marigold center stripe, endurance-racing heritage colors under honest gloss

items.name: signal-orange
items.text: 1970s signal orange in period enamel, saturated and slightly soft at the highlights

items.name: champagne-metallic
items.text: warm champagne metallic with the fine even flake of an early 1980s factory coat

items.name: opalescent-jade
items.text: opalescent jade green, the fragile 1960s metallic that shifts silver-grey as the panel turns
